rules.statement: The support request fee is USD 0.020 per billable request. One request is billed once.
A 10% volume discount applies to a task's request fee when that task's monthly billable request volume is at least 20,000.
The USD 900 monthly shared platform fee is allocated equally across the three active in-scope tasks.
A prepaid subscription for a task cancelled before period end is refundable. The vendor must issue a credit note within 10 calendar days of cancellation.
Reporting is USD-only. A non-USD line remains unnormalized unless a month-end FX rate is confirmed in writing; no rate is inferred.
The priority support add-on is USD 150.00 per month per account and is not subject to the request-volume discount.
Every billable charge must carry a task_id or an allocation rule approved before the period. Without either, attribution is unprovable.
A business outcome value enters ROI only when verified by a buyer-owned record with a source reference. A vendor claim alone remains unverified.
